column1: # KEGG BRITE pathway categories -> MSigDB C2:CP:KEGG gene-set names.
#   slug     filename stem for the plot, e.g. gsea/{contrast}/kegg/{slug}_dotplot.pdf
#   label    plot title, keeps the KEGG section number
#   gs_name  gene-set name as it appears in the collection
# Names follow the MSigDB convention: "DNA replication" -> KEGG_DNA_REPLICATION.
# Entries listed here but absent from the collection are reported as a WARNING in
# logs/GSEAKeggCategories/*.log and skipped - the plot still renders. The legacy
# C2:CP:KEGG collection is frozen at an older KEGG release, so pathways KEGG has
# added since (marked below) will usually be missing from it. Edit this file to
# add, drop or rename entries; nothing else needs changing.
